commitResults.messageTitle: Add a sequence diagram of command confirmation
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG describes in prose how MainWindow asks Logic for a prompt before
executing a destructive command, but has no diagram of it. The flow
crosses UI and Logic and parses the input twice, which is hard to follow
from the text alone.

Let's add a sequence diagram of student delete to the student commands
section. One command is enough, as group delete and assignment delete
follow the same flow. The diagram leaves out the Model to stay focused
on the confirmation.

The diagram has a ConfirmationHandler column, which exists only so that
tests can replace the dialog. At its width, the page shrinks the diagram
to 84%, so its text is smaller than the course's DG tips recommend.

Let's show the dialog as a step of MainWindow and shorten the notes,
which brings the diagram to 96%. The DG mentions the handler, as the
diagram is a simplified view.

commitResults.messageTitle: Enlarge the TAssist model diagram in the DG
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG shows the 1812-pixel model class diagram at a width of 600, so
its text is smaller than the main text and its type parameter box is
hard to read.

Let's show it at 770, the width of the page's content. Rendering it
again is not an option, as a render without Graphviz makes its labels
collide.
Add a confirmation diagram and enlarge the model diagram
